summary: Added a validated Node 24 deployment manifest and bounded graceful-shutdown coordinator, wired the existing API entrypoint to stop HTTP before MongoDB disconnect, and added multi-stage non-root Docker plus development Compose artifacts with liveness/readiness checks and an isolated MongoDB replica-set initializer. Root container artifacts and server wiring are necessary integration changes outside the task's module/test roots and are documented here.
